activity_summary: The moon is full. You said you had not put a sea on the town. You did not play the map as a joke a second time. Sunday's supper is on the book and is not tonight.

facets.activity: Said the moon was full and the town was inland

topics: the three notes left as they are

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The moon is full. I have not put a sea on the town.
